summary: INLIF Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a private placement (PIPE transaction) of 40,000 Class B ordinary shares at $2.58 per share for $103,200 gross proceeds to a single investor, Kerui Enterprise Limited. The transaction closed on July 22, 2026, two days after signing. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes and working capital. The issuance is exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S, and will not be registered under the Securities Act. No board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation dynamics are present. This is a routine capital-raising filing, not a special situation.
